stories.title: Open Banking AISP Connection & Transaction Sync
stories.user_story: As a consumer, I want the platform to securely connect to my bank accounts via Open Banking AISP so that my transaction history is available for personalised offer matching.
acceptance_criteria: Consumer grants consent via FCA-compliant Open Banking redirect flow
System retrieves transactions from authorised AISP endpoint using OAuth 2.0 tokens
Transaction data is encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3)
Circuit breaker activates after 3 consecutive failures with 30-second half-open retry
Consent status and token refresh state are persisted in Cloud SQL
Consumer can revoke consent at any time from account settings; revocation deletes synced data within 24 hours
Audit log records all consent grants, revocations, and data access events
All transaction data access is restricted to authorised service accounts via Cloud IAM policies
Screen reader announces consent flow status and completion

stories.title: Transaction Analysis Dataflow Pipeline
stories.user_story: As a platform operator, I want an automated Dataflow pipeline that processes synced transactions, groups them by MCC code, and builds spending profiles in BigQuery so that the personalisation engine can target offers accurately.
acceptance_criteria: Dataflow pipeline consumes transaction events from Pub/Sub topic in real-time
Transactions are categorised by MCC code into spending groups (e.g., groceries, dining, travel)
Spending profile is written to BigQuery partitioned by consumer_id and date
Pipeline handles at least 10,000 transactions per second at peak
Failed records are routed to a dead-letter topic for manual review
Pipeline auto-scales based on backlog size
All PII fields are pseudonymised before writing to BigQuery analytics tables
Monitoring dashboard shows pipeline lag, throughput, and error rate

stories.title: Consumer Spending Profile View
stories.user_story: As a consumer, I want to see a summary of my spending categories so that I understand why certain offers are recommended to me.
acceptance_criteria: Spending profile displays top 5 MCC categories with percentage breakdown
Data refreshes within 4 hours of new transactions syncing
Consumer can opt out of personalisation without losing access to generic offers
Visualisation uses accessible colour palette with sufficient contrast (WCAG 2.1 AA)
Chart data is available as a text-based table alternative for screen readers
Loading state is communicated via aria-live region

stories.title: Merchant Registration & Document Upload
stories.user_story: As a merchant marketer, I want to register my business via a web form and upload verification documents so that I can be onboarded to the offers platform.
acceptance_criteria: Registration form captures: business name, Companies House number, contact details, business category
Document upload accepts PDF and JPEG (max 10MB per file) for business verification
Files are stored in Cloud Storage with virus scanning before acceptance
Form validates all required fields client-side and server-side
Confirmation email sent within 60 seconds of successful submission
Form is fully keyboard-navigable with visible focus indicators
Error messages are associated with form fields via aria-describedby
Upload progress is announced to assistive technology

stories.title: Merchant Quality Review & Approval Queue
stories.user_story: As a platform operator, I want to review merchant applications in an admin queue and approve or reject them within 48 hours so that only legitimate businesses publish offers.
acceptance_criteria: Admin queue displays pending applications sorted by submission date (oldest first)
Operator can view uploaded documents inline without downloading
Approve or reject action requires a reason/note (mandatory for rejection)
Merchant receives email notification of decision within 5 minutes of action
SLA timer shows time remaining against 48-hour target with visual and text indicator
Queue supports filtering by business category and submission date
All approval/rejection actions are audit-logged with operator identity and timestamp
Queue table is accessible with proper row/column headers and sortable via keyboard
Given a screen reader is active, When the campaign creation form loads, Then all fields announce their labels, required status, and any validation errors

stories.title: Campaign & Offer Creation
stories.user_story: As a merchant marketer, I want to create a campaign with offer details, targeting rules, and redemption limits so that I can attract relevant consumers near my locations.
acceptance_criteria: Campaign form captures: title (max 60 chars), description (max 250 chars), image, discount type/value, start/end dates
Targeting rules allow selection by: spending category, radius from store, time of day
Redemption limits configurable: per-consumer limit and total campaign cap
Image upload validates dimensions (min 600x400px) and file size (max 5MB)
Draft campaigns auto-save every 30 seconds
Form fields have associated labels and validation errors announced by screen readers
Colour contrast of all form elements meets WCAG 2.1 AA (4.5:1 minimum)

stories.title: Campaign Preview & Publish
stories.user_story: As a merchant marketer, I want to preview my campaign as consumers will see it and then publish it so that I can verify the offer appearance before it goes live.
acceptance_criteria: Preview renders offer card exactly as it appears in the consumer mobile app
Preview is available on desktop and mobile viewport sizes
Publish action requires confirmation dialog before activation
Published campaign status changes to 'Active' and becomes visible to targeted consumers within 5 minutes
Merchant cannot edit live campaigns — must pause, edit, then republish
Preview mode is navigable by keyboard and announces content structure to screen readers
Confirmation dialog traps focus and is dismissible via Escape key

stories.title: Merchant Analytics Dashboard
stories.user_story: As a merchant marketer, I want to view campaign performance metrics including impressions, redemptions, and engagement rate so that I can measure ROI and optimise future campaigns.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard displays: total impressions, redemptions, engagement rate (redemptions/impressions), revenue attributed
Date range selector allows custom range and presets (7d, 30d, 90d)
Charts update within 3 seconds of date range change
Data exportable as CSV with all visible metrics and date range
Dashboard refreshes metrics at most 1 hour behind real-time
Charts include text alternatives and data tables for screen reader users
Interactive chart elements are keyboard-focusable with tooltip content in aria-label
Export button has accessible name describing the action and file format

stories.title: Circuit Breaker & Resilience for Payment Provider Integration
stories.user_story: As a platform operator, I want circuit breaker patterns on all Open Banking AISP connections so that downstream provider failures do not cascade and degrade the platform.
acceptance_criteria: Circuit breaker transitions: Closed → Open after 3 failures in 60 seconds
Half-open state allows 1 probe request after 30-second cooldown
Open circuit returns cached last-known-good data where available, or graceful degradation message
Circuit state changes emit alerts to Cloud Monitoring with PagerDuty integration
Dashboard shows per-provider circuit state (Closed/Open/Half-Open) in real-time
Metrics recorded: failure count, open duration, recovery time per provider
Alert notifications meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast requirements in operator dashboard
